item.title: D4vd Murder Case: A Timeline of the Investigation & Charges Over Celeste Rivas Hernandez’s Death
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest news and updates. Today, we're discussing a shocking case involving 21-year-old pop singer D4vd, known for his 2022 hit "Romantic Homicide."
[Soft music continues in the background]
Host: According to prosecutors, D4vd, whose real name is David Anthony Burke, is facing first-degree murder charges for allegedly killing and dismembering the body of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez. The alleged murder occurred on April 23, 2025, just two days before the release of his debut album, Withered.
[Pause for a brief moment]
Host: Prosecutors claim that D4vd was having an illegal sexual relationship with the teenager and murdered her after she threatened to expose his actions, which could have devastated his musical career. Months later, police discovered Rivas' decomposed and dismembered body in an impounded Tesla registered to D4vd.
[Soft music continues]
Host: D4vd has pleaded not guilty to all charges, and his attorneys say they will "vigorously defend" him in court. They claim that the actual evidence will show that David Burke did not murder Celeste Rivas Hernandez and was not the cause of her death.
[Pause for a brief moment]
Host: The case has already had significant consequences for D4vd's career. His headlining Withered tour was cut short, and a deluxe version of the album got shelved. He was then dropped by his record label, publishing company, and management team.
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: That's the latest on D4vd's case. We'll keep you updated as more information becomes available. For now, that's all for today's episode. Thank you for tuning in.
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
